globals_.cold_rule: Cold is felt through breath, wind and grade, not decorative snow. Falling snow only where the sky is overcast or night (S01_SH005, S03_SH010, S08_SH001-003): wind-driven diagonal, 3 depth layers (far: tiny, slow, sharp, 60 % of flakes; mid; near: large, soft, motion-blurred, fast, rare), gusts every 3-5 s, never a crisp dot on a face, hand, photo or letter, alpha 0 on frame 0 and fades in over 0.5 s. Clear golden dawn/dusk shots get NO falling snow: ground spindrift (low blowing snow at the ground, bottom 25 % only), drifting frost haze, smoke bent by the wind, breath on every visible face.
globals_.breath_rule: Breath on every visible face in an exterior or open-trench shot: a puff every 2.8-3.6 s (desynchronised per person), rising 0.6-0.8 s, peak opacity 0.30-0.40, clearly visible on a phone screen; never on a face seen from behind, never inside a dugout with a fire close by.
globals_.move_rule: Only the element moves, never its support: flame not candle/brazier, steam not mug, smoke not chimney, cloth edge not pole.

globals_.voice: Narrator: the ElevenLabs reads of 2026-11-13 (Odom, 33 lines, text identical to the current script, measured clock in demo_truce_1914/clock). Dialogue: the LTX clips' own voices (the creator's choice of 11-13), every line checked by Whisper on 11-15; fixes: S06_SH008 start at 1.45 s (double 'Maybe'), S03_SH003 play to its end (cut word), S03_SH007 muted (false words in noise). ElevenLabs character reads stay as the fallback for any clip whose voice fails the ear check. No paid voice step.
globals_.clip_sound: Video shots with a line: the clip's own audio is the dialogue. Narrated or silent video shots: the clip's own sound at -12 dB (switch Q2, creator 11-13) ducked under the narrator, except where the shot says otherwise.
globals_.staging: Every spot sound is panned to its source's x in the picture (pan = 2x-1) and set by distance (close 0 dB, mid -6, far -12); during a push its level rises up to +3 dB as the camera closes; beds change with the place (open field: wind; trench: wind low + crackle; dugout: wind low-passed). The old one-bed-everywhere (fire + calm wind) is replaced.
globals_.library_gaps: Not in the free library: rifle crack (S02_SH004 sniper), scissors (S05_SH006), coin/button touch (S08_SH002), distant real artillery (amb_low_rumble stands in). Plan: leave those silent (no paid step); the gunshots of S07 come from the LTX clips. Optional later: ElevenLabs SFX ~4 takes, about 0.10 USD, only on the creator's word.

shots.mood: the sun goes down; they stay
shots.see: two men seen from behind sitting together in no man's land (.42-.55, .4-.6), sunset behind the ruined farm (.65, .25), trench with lamps right-front (.8-.95, .5-.8), brazier left (.15, .63), smoke from the dugout (.15, .2-.4)
shots.cam: slow pull back (reverse push) from the two men (.5, .5) to the wide, 5.5 s (runner split: hold then pull), the men stay centred
shots.live: sunset dims: light going down over 5 s (grade toward blue, -15 % exposure at the end); lamps and brazier get relatively brighter; smoke bends; no breath (seen from behind)
shots.keep: the two men centred and whole
shots.snd: bed: dusk wind, brazier crackle left; everything thins as the light goes
shots.tr: dip to black 0.8 s (night -> next morning)

lines: The next morning, the men drifted back to their own trenches.

shots.cam: slow push down the field (target (.5, .35)), 4.25 s
shots.live: fog drift (visible), sun shafts; lamps flicker; breath none (backs)
shots.snd: bed: morning wind; many slow footsteps in snow (footstep_snow, layered, panned both ways)

lines: Thomas wrote home that night. So did many others. In January, British newspapers printed their letters.

shots.live: candle flame + spill on the paper (strength 1.2); brazier far right; light falling snow in the open trench ONLY (right third, x > .7, far layer, never inside the dugout)
shots.cold: warm interior vs blue cold outside
shots.still: the writing hand (do not animate the pencil), candle body
shots.snd: bed: night wind outside, muffled (low-pass) because we are inside; pencil scratching (pencil_scribble, close, centre); candle silent
